summary: Fix paired-device key durability, revocation persistence, and storage path checks from the Codex review.
risks: A failed save can leave a renamed file on disk while the call throws.

tasks.title: Propagate key directory fsync failure
tasks.change: Do not reload a key and return success when directory fsync fails after rename.
tasks.effect: ensureKey throws STATE_UNSAFE after an injected directory fsync failure.

verification.risk_reason: A caller would treat an undurable signing key as saved.
verification.test_reason: Existing tests cannot inject a directory fsync failure after rename.
verification.subject: ensureKey directory fsync failure
verification.procedure: Inject fsyncSync failure for a directory fd and call ensureKey.
verification.pass_criterion: The call throws STATE_UNSAFE and does not return a public key.

tasks.title: Fail closed on revocation save
tasks.change: Mark the device revoked before save and merge disk revocations before every later save.
tasks.effect: Existing tokens are rejected after a failed save, and a disk revocation survives a later save.

verification.risk_reason: A failed revocation would keep accepting tokens or erase a revocation already on disk.
verification.test_reason: Existing tests only cover a successful revocation save.
verification.subject: revocation save failure and disk reconcile
verification.procedure: Inject file and directory fsync failures during revoke, then save again. Also write a revocation to disk and pair another device.
verification.pass_criterion: Tokens are rejected and the revoked device stays revoked on disk.

tasks.title: Reject unsafe storage paths before writes
tasks.change: lstat every ancestor and recheck directory owner and mode 0700 before each write.
tasks.effect: Symlinked ancestors and group-writable directories are rejected before bytes change.

verification.risk_reason: A symlinked ancestor or loosened directory mode could redirect or expose state.
verification.test_reason: Existing checks only lstat the final directory at open.
verification.subject: ancestor symlink and directory mode
verification.procedure: Use a real ancestor symlink, an injected parent symlink, injected mode and uid, and chmod 0770 before confirm.
verification.pass_criterion: Each case throws STATE_UNSAFE and an existing state file is unchanged.

tasks.title: Remove alternate approval paths and cap expired challenges
tasks.change: State that approval happens only on the tailnet page and bound expired challenge ids to 1024.
tasks.effect: The doc no longer treats chat as a decision path, and the expired id set cannot grow without limit.

verification.risk_reason: An unbounded set can grow with expired challenges, and the doc still described chat decisions.
verification.test_reason: The cap is new behavior. The doc change is checked by reading the edited section.
verification.subject: expired challenge bound
verification.procedure: Issue and expire 1025 challenges, then exchange the oldest and the next id.
verification.pass_criterion: The oldest id is AUTH_INVALID and a retained id is AUTH_EXPIRED.
